text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day... I was troubled by a case of 
hiccups that just wouldn't stop.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Big brother, do you have the hiccups?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Big sister, do you have the hiccups?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hiccups are so funny. You're not 
doing anything, yet you just go *hic, 
hic*.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Carelessness is our greatest enemy. They 
say if it goes on for too long, it could 
be a sign of a serious illness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fueeeh!? R-Really...!? Oh no, are you 
okay, dear brother...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fueeeh!? R-Really...!? Oh no, are you 
okay, dear sister...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa! Didn't they say getting scared 
stops it!? Get scared, Big Brother! Boo! 
Uu~, boo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa! Didn't they say getting scared 
stops it!? Get scared, Big Sister! Boo! 
Uu~, boo!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, if you wish to surprise someone, 
I recommend a method that catches them 
more off-guard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Got it. Rice will do her best 
to surprise them!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-Here it comes... Inhale... Exhale... All 
right... I'll burst right out...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Urara-♪ Rice-chaaan! What are you doing~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, U-Urara-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know! You're playing hide-and-seek, 
right? Let me play too~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawa... W-Wait. Right now isn't 
hide-and-seek...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: P-Peek-a-boo...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh!? Why won't it stop...!? Ugh, stop, 
please stop...!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Situation analysis: judged as "lacking 
impact." To achieve the "Surprised" 
status, momentum and volume are requested.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fuehh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine this time... When Big 
Brother comes, I'll leap right out of the 
storehouse...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine this time... When Big Sister 
comes, I'll leap right out of the 
storehouse...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle! Clatter!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? The door won't open...!? Eek, 
whyyy...!?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? I couldn't scare them at 
all... ...Rice is such a bad girl...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice-san, please come over here for a 
moment. I would like to increase the 
success rate of our strategy."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice-san's Trainer. Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
From what I've observed, Rice-san's 
gentleness prevents her from genuinely 
scaring you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Therefore, you will undergo modification.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If Rice-san becomes a cyborg with a heart 
of steel, the success rate of this 
operation should increase significantly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Unsurprised, as expected. 
Determined the overly dramatic premise to 
be the cause. Mission failed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: K-Kaboom!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean... it's just Rice, but... were 
you... surprised...? How're... your 
hiccups...?"
choice_data_list:
I feel like even my heart is about to 
stop.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-Really? Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"A surprise ambush the moment they let 
their guard down —mission complete."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Miss Bourbon. 
Thank you for suggesting that strategy...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If it were just Rice alone, Onii-sama 
might have... had the hiccups forever and 
ever...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If it were just Rice alone, Onee-sama 
might have... had the hiccups forever and 
ever...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, thank goodness...! Bourbon-san, 
thank you so very much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was just a minor case of 
hiccups, I was truly grateful to the two 
of them for worrying and trying their 
best...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh...!? D-Did I startle them too 
much...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What do I do in a situation like this...!? 
What's the opposite of scaring 
someone...!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: To bring relief—would that be it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san said so herself. She told me 
that patting heads and playing peek-a-boo 
is very effective.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-All right, just like Creek-san... Good 
girl, good girl... good girl, good 
girl...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now Rice Shower desperately tried to calm 
her racing heart.
